**Week of Nov 30** · Paired lecture: *Pair presentations*

## What happens today

Robots are scored in two categories: **most efficient** and **fastest**.

## Before you arrive

| | |
|---|---|
| **Bring** | Robot, spare crank–linkage shaft, spare wing, charged packs, your logged cost-of-transport data |

::: {.callout-important}
## To be written by the instructor

Competition format is course material, not in the manufacturing guide. Needed:

- Course layout and run rules for each category
- How cost of transport is computed and normalised across teams with different
  masses
- Number of attempts, and repair rules between attempts
- How the competition contributes to the grade
- What happens to robots afterwards
:::

## Feedback

The final session is a recap and feedback round. This manual is rebuilt each
year from what students report --- if something in it cost you time, say so.
Corrections made during this semester are listed in the
[Changelog](../changelog.qmd).
